page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at top, with the page number at the left. The text starts with the end of a paragraph from the previous page, followed by a heading "CONCIO XX.", a reference "Iudic. 14.", and one paragraph opened by a woodcut initial.

main_text.l: Dominum Deum invocet omnis in tribula-
verit eum in veritate, salvus erit. Ipsi ergo de-
betur benedictio, honor, potestas in secula

l.i: dicavit patri suo atq; matri suæ, dicens:
Mulierem vidi in Thimnath de filiab.
mihi in uxorem. Ad quem autem pater
suus atque mater sua: Nunquid non est
in filiabus fratrum tuorum, & in omni
populo meo mulier, quod tu vadis accipe-
respondit Simson patri suo: Hanc mihi ac-
cipe, quoniam recta visa est in oculis me-
is. Pater autem eius & mater eius nescie-
bant, quod à Domino hoc esset, quodq; oc-

page.notes: The initial is a woodcut D, joined to the first word "Escendens", which is printed "Efcendens"; the first letter is doubtful, so it is marked [?]. The small mark before "Mulierem" and before "Ad quem" is a printed quotation sign and is not transcribed. "quodq;" is doubtful and marked [?] in the word itself as read at its first occurrence, so the word itself is a doubtful reading. The reference "Iudic. 14." is set apart as a verse reference, level 3. "eius" at the foot is a catchword and is placed in bottom_margin, not in the text. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
